name: Feathers
overview: Scripture uses feathers and wings as powerful symbols of God's protective care and sustaining power, as seen in Exodus 19:4 and Deuteronomy 32:11 where God is likened to an eagle bearing and nurturing His people. The imagery of hiding under the shadow of God's wings in Psalms 17:8 highlights the intimate safety and refuge believers find in Him. Additionally, the detailed references to feathers in Leviticus 1:16 and Job 39:13 reflect God's sovereign design over creation, emphasizing His authority and wisdom in all things.
